input: Enroll in a night class on urban history

gold.taskTitle: Enroll in a Night Class on Urban History
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to find and enroll in a night class focused on urban history.

questions.title: Which city or region's urban history interests you most?
questions.description: Understand the geographic focus of the urban history content the user wants to study.

questions.title: Are you looking for a credited course or casual learning?
questions.description: Determine whether the user wants an accredited academic course or a non-credit community/continuing education class.

questions.title: Do you have a specific institution type in mind?
questions.description: Find out if the user prefers a university, community college, museum, library, or other type of provider.

questions.title: What is your target start date or enrollment deadline?
questions.description: Establish a timeline so the search can be scoped to currently or soon-to-be available classes.

questions.title: Would you attend in person or is online acceptable?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user needs a physical night class or is open to a virtual evening course.

questions.title: What is your budget for tuition or enrollment fees?
questions.description: Identify any financial constraints that would filter out certain course options.

questions.title: Do you have any prior background in history or urban studies?
questions.description: Gauge the user's experience level to match them with beginner, intermediate, or advanced course offerings.
